title: Polynomial-time decidability of comparison
statement: Let $z$ be a finite binary string, and let $a$ and $b$ be the two binary strings obtained by parsing it as a pair encoding, using the empty string for either projection when the parse is invalid. Consider the language of strings $z$ for which the natural number represented by $a$ is strictly less than the natural number represented by $b$; this language is decidable in polynomial time.
